_about: Where each view sits on a turnaround sheet (pixels on the full-size sheet, from the top-left). x0/x1 bound the view, base_x is the centre of its footprint, y0/y1 crop away anything above or below it. split_views.py cuts each view onto a same-size grey canvas with the footprint at the same place, so all views share one scale (for multi-view 3D lifts and for comparing renders). Optional "clear" rectangles [x0, y0, x1, y1] (sheet pixels) are painted grey first, to remove bits of neighbouring views that reach into a box.
